name: ASUS Aura USB (motherboards, addressable controllers)
description: Per-LED lighting of the ASUS Aura USB controllers of motherboards (onboard LEDs and RGB headers, addressable headers as channels), the older Aura Addressable controllers, the ROG Strix LC III cooler and the ROG AURA Terminal. Adapted from OpenRGB's AsusAuraUSBController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The commit (save) command and hardware effects are never sent. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/asus-aura-usb.md.
